overview.pattern: wiring-only composition root + pure strictly-typed core
overview.description: setup.py does real IO; installer/ package is pure, pyright strict, >=90% covered (.claude/architecture.md)

data-flow.flow: registry.toml -> model.load_tools -> resolve.resolve_methods/deps.resolve_dependencies -> catalog_tui selection -> session.run_installs -> engine.install_tool -> executors.execute (download/apps/run) -> status/version_status/ownership refresh
data-flow.description: one view registry, one nav path, one apply workflow

component:Registry.responsibility: declarative tool catalog: methods, requires, skills lifecycle

component:Resolver.responsibility: pick install method per platform; dependency order/cycles

component:Executor.responsibility: run installs; checksum-verified downloads; host_setup handoff (no sudo)

component:Ownership/receipts.responsibility: which manager owns a path; drives update/uninstall safety

component:Policies.path: installer/policy.py, agent_policy.py, env_redirect.py, daemon.py, systemd_daemon.py, tweaks.py, omz.py, guards.py
component:Policies.responsibility: opt-in host policies, swept on uninstall

security.rules: zero sudo/pkexec/doas; atomic writes (installer/atomic.py); sha256 checks (installer/checksums.py); never mutate dev host; e2e only in containers

conventions.gates: make validate && make test before commit
